props.description: HTML element to render the container as. Typography is controlled by `size`/`weight`, not by the element — so the element is purely semantic.

props.description: Render onto the single child element (e.g. wrap a `Heading` or `Text`) via Radix Slot, instead of AnimatedText's own element — so the animated text keeps the wrapped component's typography. The child's text content is what gets split.

props.name: once
props.description: For inView/hover triggers, animate only the first time (do not re-run on re-entry)

props.name: nowrap

components.name: Chart
components.description: Token-aware chart shell. Owns the frame, scales, accessible name, data-table alternative, legend, tooltip, hover emphasis and async status; delegates drawing to a swappable renderer. The built-in renderer is Move-owned React SVG over its own scale and path maths, so the package takes on no charting dependency; libraries plug in as optional adapters. Covers line, area, bar and scatter over a shared axis (category or linear x, three interpolations, stacking, reference lines, and `axes={false}` for a sparkline), plus pie and donut, which share none of that machinery and take their own path.

props.name: data
props.description: Row-oriented source data. One object per x position.

props.name: x
props.description: Key in each row holding the x/category value.

props.name: series
props.description: One entry per drawn series: { key, type, label?, color?, axis?, dash? }. Order fixes draw order and legend order.

props.name: caption
props.description: Chart title. Renders as the figcaption and supplies the accessible name — required, because a chart without one is unusable non-visually. Named `caption` rather than `title` so it cannot collide with the HTML title attribute.

props.name: hideCaption
props.description: Visually hide the caption while keeping it in the accessibility tree.

props.name: summary
props.description: Optional one-line trend summary announced before the data table. When absent the shell derives one from the series (first/last value and direction).

props.name: renderer
props.description: Swap the drawing layer for a charting library. Falls back to the built-in SVG renderer when omitted.

props.name: resource
props.description: Async source status. Drives the loading, error, retry, and empty states so they are shell-owned rather than per-renderer.

props.name: size
props.description: Scales tick font size, stroke width, point radius, and tick density.

props.name: grid
props.description: Which grid lines the renderer draws.

props.name: legend
props.description: Render the series legend below the plot.

props.name: tooltip
props.description: Show every series' value at the hovered position. Rendered by the shell over the plot, so it looks and behaves the same for any renderer that reports its plot rect.

props.name: dots
props.description: Mark each data point on line and area series.

props.name: rules
props.description: Reference lines across the plot — a target, a budget, an SLA, an average. Annotations rather than series: they carry no data of their own, they give the data something to be read against. A rule extends the value domain, so a target above everything achieved still appears. Ignored by a pie, which has no value axis.

props.name: axes
props.description: Draw the tick labels and baseline. Off makes a sparkline: the margins collapse with them, so the drawing fills the box. Pair with grid="none", legend={false} and tooltip={false}.

props.name: innerRadius
props.description: Hole size for a pie, as a fraction of the radius. 0 is a full pie, around 0.6 reads as a donut. Ignored by every other series type.

props.name: xScale
props.description: How x positions are derived. `category` spaces rows evenly by index; `linear` places each at its own numeric x, which is what unevenly sampled or time-series data needs — a category axis would draw equal gaps between unequal intervals. Timestamps are numbers: pass epoch milliseconds and a `formatX`. Falls back to `category` if any x value is not finite.

props.name: curve
props.description: How line and area paths travel between points. `monotone` smooths without inventing peaks the data does not contain.

props.name: stacked
props.description: Stack bar and area series sharing an axis instead of overlaying them.

props.name: aspect
props.description: Width-to-height ratio for the viewport. Ignored when `height` is set.

props.name: height
props.description: Explicit plot height. Overrides `aspect` when set.

props.name: palette
props.description: Override the categorical series ramp with Move color names. Defaults to the theme-derived ramp.

props.name: formatX
props.description: Format x tick labels and the data-table header column.

props.name: formatY
props.description: Format y tick labels, data-table cells, and the derived summary.

props.name: dataTable
props.description: Render the visually hidden data table. Turn off only when an equivalent table is already on the page.

props.name: animations
props.description: Override or disable the series entrance animation.
